content: A dramatic anime action illustration inside an old wooden martial arts hall, showing two young women in mid-battle with explosive motion and elemental energy trails. In the foreground, a fierce female martial artist lunges low toward the viewer in a powerful punching stance, her right fist extended straight ahead and her body twisted dynamically. She has dark black hair tied into a messy high bun with loose strands and red ribbons, sharp intense eyes, and a focused combative expression. She wears a white traditional Chinese martial arts top with red trim, red tassel frog closures, and subtle embroidered patterns, paired with flowing deep red pants and black cloth shoes with red accents. Red ribbon-like energy and glowing scarlet brushstroke arcs coil around her arms, torso, and legs, sweeping across the frame like fiery calligraphy. In the upper right, a second young woman leaps through the air in a defensive or spellcasting pose, one hand stretched outward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light purple"} hair styled in two buns with trailing strands and ornate gold hair ornaments. She wears a dark green Chinese-style dress with gold embroidery, black stockings, and dark shoes. Bright blue water-like energy spirals around her in a large circular arc, splashing and glittering with luminous droplets. Set the scene in a weathered dojo or wuguan interior with tall wooden beams, hanging lanterns, broken floorboards, flying splinters, dust, sparks, and debris exploding from the impact of the fight. Include one large wooden signboard above them with the black calligraphy text 武术会, plus two vertical hanging banners, the left reading 以武会友 and the right reading 刚柔并济. Use a low-angle cinematic perspective, strong foreshortening, extreme motion, dense particles, and dramatic warm-vs-cool color contrast between the red and blue energy. Highly detailed anime painting, ultra-dynamic composition, sharp linework, rich textures, glowing effects, volumetric lighting, and epic battle key visual quality.

A vertical anime-inspired wedding key visual poster that blends live-action cosplay-style newlyweds in the foreground with illustrated anime girls surrounding them, set in front of a sunlit stone church under a brilliant deep blue sky. In the center foreground, a bride and groom pose for a dramatic selfie-like shot with their arms reaching toward the viewer. The groom is a youthful androgynous character with {argument name="hair color" default="light brown"} shaggy short hair, wearing a crisp white wedding suit, white shirt, and white tie, smiling and making a playful hand sign near his face. The bride has {argument name="hair color" default="dark purple-black"} hair in short twin tails and wears an ornate white wedding dress with layered lace, veil, pearl choker, long white gloves, and holds a bouquet of white roses. Behind them rises a beautiful European-style church with a tall steeple, floral garlands over the entrance, stained glass, and warm sunlight bursting from the left side, creating lens flare and sparkling highlights. The sky is filled with fluffy white clouds, flying white birds, a faint rainbow streak, and drifting pink flower petals. Around the edges are 6 anime schoolgirl portraits in dark school uniforms with red or yellow ribbon bows, each showing a different emotional expression: top left brown-haired girl reaching forward, upper left purple-haired girl with an eyepatch looking flustered, lower left pink-haired cheerful girl, top right brown-haired girl extending a gloved hand, mid-right dark-haired boy in school uniform, lower right brown-haired shy girl, and bottom right small blonde girl with an excited open-mouth expression. Add ornate decorative corner filigree framing the poster. Include vertical Japanese tagline text on the upper right reading {argument name="tagline text" default="さあ、契約の時間だ— 私たちの永遠を誓おう"}. Place a large colorful Japanese title across the bottom center reading {argument name="title text" default="中二病でも恋がしたい！"} in bold blue and pink outlined typography, with a small romanized subtitle beneath it reading "Chu-2 byo demo KOI ga shitai!" and small credits near the bottom reading {argument name="credit text" default="富樫勇太　小鳥遊六花"}. Overall look: dazzling, romantic, sentimental, nostalgic anime movie poster, ultra-detailed, glossy lighting, magical sparkle effects, vivid colors, polished promotional composition.

A traditional Chinese ink wash hanging-scroll painting on warm aged rice paper, vertical composition, with six large vertical columns of bold black brush-calligraphy occupying the upper and right half of the image. The calligraphy should be highly legible expressive Chinese cursive-regular script with varied ink density and natural brush taper, reading from right to left in 6 columns: "金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱", "停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然", "欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山", "闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边", "行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在", "长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海". Add one smaller vertical inscription on the left side reading "李白行路难" with a small red seal stamp beneath it. In the lower left foreground, depict an ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing white and pale gray robes with a blue sash, long black hair in a traditional topknot with loose strands and ribbon, standing on the edge of a dark rocky cliff, body angled right and head lifted upward in a contemplative, heroic pose. Below and across the lower half, paint a turbulent river or sea with white crashing waves in monochrome ink and soft gray washes; in the distance, faint misty mountains and fog dissolve into the paper. Classical literati painting style, dynamic calligraphy as the main focus, poetic and majestic mood, restrained palette of black ink, gray wash, off-white paper, and a small touch of muted blue on the robe, ample negative space, museum-quality Chinese shanshui and calligraphy fusion.

A traditional Chinese ink wash hanging-scroll style painting on warm off-white rice paper, vertically composed with large black brush-calligraphy occupying the upper and right-central area and a poetic landscape illustration in the lower left and bottom. The calligraphy must be crisp, fully legible, and written in expressive semi-cursive brush script, arranged in 6 vertical columns read right to left. The exact text of the 6 columns is: “金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱”, “停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然”, “欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山”, “闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边”, “行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在”, “长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海”. Add a smaller vertical signature inscription to the left of the main poem reading “李白行路难”, plus 1 small red square seal beneath the inscription. In the painted scene, show 1 ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing pale robes with a dark topknot and trailing ribbons, standing on the edge of a rugged cliff at lower left, gazing upward and outward in contemplation. Below and across the lower half, depict a turbulent river or sea with whitecaps and foam, misty ink-wash mountains receding in the distance, sparse grasses and dark brush vegetation near the cliff edge, and soft atmospheric fog. Use monochrome black and gray ink with very restrained muted blue-gray washes in the water and robe shadows. The mood is heroic, melancholic, and literary, evoking classical Chinese shanshui painting and museum-quality calligraphy, with empty negative space preserved around the text and landscape.

A cinematic vertical portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} shown from the chest up in a close half-body composition, positioned slightly right of center, with her body turned to the right and her head turned back toward the camera in a restrained over-the-shoulder pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long black hair"}, loose and slightly messy, being blown strongly through the frame so many strands lift outward and sweep across the air around her face and shoulders. Her visible styling is elegant and minimal: a dark thin-strap slip dress or camisole exposing the shoulder line, collarbone, and upper back, with a sheer black off-shoulder wrap or translucent outer layer slipping down the arms to create a soft dark framing shape around the lower body. The mood is cold, quiet, mysterious, and wistful, with a high-fashion cinematic realism rather than glamour polish. Use dramatic backlighting from the upper left, creating a bright halo along the hair, shoulder, and edge of the body, while the front of the figure stays mostly in shadow with only extremely soft fill light. The face is largely obscured in darkness and soft haze, emphasizing silhouette, neck, ear, shoulder, and luminous hair edges more than facial detail. The background is a dark gray to near-black empty space with 2 clear environmental elements: floating dust-like particles and soft circular bokeh light spots scattered mostly on the left side and around the hair. Overall color grading is low saturation with cool blue-gray shadows and slightly warm skin tones for subtle warm-cool contrast. Add diffused bloom, misty atmosphere, faint film grain, soft vignette, and shallow depth of field. Keep the eyes and lips de-emphasized or hidden in shadow, avoid hard frontal light, avoid bright busy background details, avoid cartoon styling, avoid oversharpening, and avoid plastic skin texture.

A cinematic fantasy scene inside a rocky cave during a blizzard, viewed from slightly above campfire level, with 8 characters seated in a circle around a small fire. Outside the cave mouth, a colossal dark mountain rises in the snowstorm, shaped like a sinister pyramid or volcanic fortress, split with glowing crimson-magenta fissures and crowned by a branching, ember-like red energy bloom at the summit; a ring of lava or fire glows at its base across the frozen landscape. The cave interior is warm, amber, and intimate, lit by the fire and a single ornate oil lamp on the right, contrasting with the cold blue-gray storm outside. The group should feel like a high-fantasy adventuring party resting together: 1 regal bird-like humanoid on the left with white feathers, a hooked beak, braided plumage, and layered tribal jewelry; 1 red-haired woman in the left foreground with long braided hair and ornate fantasy garments; 1 young elf-like traveler in blue sitting left of center; 1 small blond elf-like girl at center with pointed ears and clasped hands; 1 elderly king-like man on the right with long white hair, full beard, crown, and dark green robe with gold ornamentation; 1 elegant blond noblewoman beside him in embroidered formal dress; 1 white-haired figure in the foreground right seen mostly from behind in feathered or fur-trimmed clothing; and 1 blue-skinned aquatic-looking woman on the far right with a fin-like headdress, elaborate jewelry, and a cup in hand. Include cups, bowls, plates, bedrolls, sacks, and travel gear scattered around the cave edges. The composition should frame the terrifying glowing mountain through the cave opening behind the party, emphasizing the contrast between sheltered companionship and looming apocalyptic danger. Ultra-detailed textures, realistic fabric and skin, dramatic volumetric firelight, snow streaks driven by wind, moody dark fantasy color grading, painterly realism, epic film still atmosphere, high contrast, rich shadows, masterpiece quality.
